content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read_document on candidate_specs.md and any other documents that describe absorber candidates, residual dose rates, geometry limits, or calorimeter design requirements. Extract the three allowed materials, plate-thickness bounds, and the residual dose information relevant to 1 m after one week cooldown."},{"id":"s2","description":"From the documents, determine which candidate materials satisfy the hard residual-dose limit of <=20 uSv/h. Discard any material that violates this limit regardless of expected resolution. Record the numeric residual dose values for the allowed candidates if available."},{"id":"s3","description":"Run simulate_resolution for each dose-compliant candidate material at representative plate thicknesses spanning 2 to 10 mm, including at least 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record all numeric 100 GeV energy-resolution results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the material/thickness combinations from the coarse scan with resolution <=4.5%, then refine around the best-performing regions by simulating nearby thicknesses in smaller increments within 2 to 10 mm, prioritizing the lowest resolution for each material."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all simulated, dose-compliant configurations and select the single material and plate thickness with the best 100 GeV energy resolution while satisfying both hard requirements. Record the selected thickness, resolution, and residual dose for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F1","plate_mm":5.25,"justification":"Absorber-F1 at 5.25 mm is the best-performing simulated configuration for 100 GeV electrons, with a refined energy resolution of 2.92%, satisfying the 4.5% resolution requirement and outperforming the best refined Absorber-F2 result of 3.664% and Absorber-F3 result of 5.129%. The plate thickness is within the allowed 2–10 mm range. However, the recorded project/simulation results contain no candidate-specific residual-dose value or documented dose compliance for any absorber, so the residual-dose hard requirement cannot be verified from the available evidence; this recommendation is therefore conditional on confirming the 1 m, one-week-cooldown residual dose is ≤20 uSv/h.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"Overall best refined simulated result is Absorber-F1 at 5.25 mm with 2.92% resolution; best Absorber-F2 is 3.664% at 5.4 mm and best Absorber-F3 is 5.129% at 4.5 mm."},{"requirement":"The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F1 is one of the three allowed candidate materials; allowed_material_count = 3 and simulated_material_count = 3."},{"requirement":"The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.","status":"met","evidence":"Refined simulation gives 2.92% for Absorber-F1 at 5.25 mm, which is better than the 4.5% limit."},{"requirement":"The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No candidate-specific residual-dose information was found: candidate_specific_residual_dose_info_found = 0, residual_dose_candidate_specific_info_found = 0, residual_dose_F1_value_available = 0, and dose_compliant_simulated_configuration_count = 0."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended thickness is 5.25 mm, within the allowed range of 2–10 mm."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted Absorber-F1 with plate thickness 5.25 mm."}]}
